LK_ExtraProfessionSkill_UnlockDesc.en:
"The mortal world, with its trials and hardships, tempers the heart. Without experiencing the ways of the world, one can never truly understand the Tao..."

{0}, with {1}'s body, walked the Martial World path,
having fulfilled their aspirations through years of enduring worldly trials and observing mortal passions.
Now, reflecting on the past, {2} feels a surge of emotion, and unexpectedly gains profound insight in Tao...

<color=#brightblue>({3} has attained enlightenment and gained the trait of Fulfilled Aspiration,
Should new realizations dawn in the future, further growth awaits...)</color>
LK_ExtraProfessionSkill_UnlockDesc.cn:
“红尘风霜，炼人心境，不阅世情，终难悟道。”

{0}以{1}身，行江湖路，
历经红尘风霜，遍览俗世人情，如此经年累月，已然志向有成，
而今{2}思及往事，一时有所感怀，不觉间竟然识性悟道……

<color=#brightblue>({3}识性悟道，已获得志向有成特性，
今后若然另生感悟，亦将重有所获……）</color>

LK_Feature_Wisdom_Desc.en:
The higher the [Tactic] strategy, the more likely the character is to receive [Rapid Advance], [Pull Back], [Heal], [Detoxify], and [True Qi] support commands...
If there is no [Tactic] strategy, one support command will be reduced...
The level of [Tactic] determines the first-move advantage in battles and Debates...
The higher the [Tactic], the more items the character can use in battle...
The higher the [Tactic], the more topics the character can reveal at the start of a Debate...
LK_Feature_Wisdom_Desc.cn:
「机略」策略越高，人物越可能获得「迅进」、「拉回」、「疗伤」、「驱毒」、「真气」助战指令…
若无「机略」策略，减少一个助战指令。
「机略」的高低决定着战斗、较艺的先手后情况…
「机略」越高，人物在战斗中就能使用越多的物品…
机略越高，人物在较艺开始时就能探明越多较艺的主题…

LK_Goodness_Desc_1.en: Доброжелательный человек обладает исключительной добродетелью.Они способны на самопожертвование, чтобы помочь уязвимым, и бескорыстную преданность делу спасения мира. Они могут отплатить за обиды добротой, сияющей, как чистое золото и необработанный Нефрит.
LK_Goodness_Desc_1.cn: 慈悲仁善者，品行殊高洁。\n扶危能够舍己，济世能够忘我。可以报怨以德，宛然浑金璞玉一般。
LK_Goodness_Desc_1.ru: Доброжелательный человек обладает исключительной добродетелью.Они способны на самопожертвование, чтобы помочь уязвимым, и бескорыстную преданность делу спасения мира. Они могут отплатить за обиды добротой, сияющей, как чистое золото и необработанный Нефрит.

LK_Goodness_Desc_2.en: Умеренный человек всегда остается спокойным.Они плывут по течению и никогда не впадают в крайности. Они рассматривают добро и зло как две стороны одного целого и верят в закон природы.
LK_Goodness_Desc_2.cn: 中庸无为者，处世不偏不倚。\n凡事顺其自然，但求折中调和。心中既少了正邪之分，或许终能成就开明大道？
LK_Goodness_Desc_2.ru: Умеренный человек всегда остается спокойным.Они плывут по течению и никогда не впадают в крайности. Они рассматривают добро и зло как две стороны одного целого и верят в закон природы.

LK_Goodness_Desc_3.en: Бунтарь не верит в социальные нормы.\Они получают удовольствие от каприза, а не от добродетели, от зла, а не от добра, и от жестокости, а не от доброты.
LK_Goodness_Desc_3.cn: 叛逆处世者，直性狭中、黑白颠倒。\n“应笑”而不笑、“应喜”而不喜、“应慈”而不慈、“闻恶”而不改、“闻善”而不乐。
LK_Goodness_Desc_3.ru: Бунтарь не верит в социальные нормы.\Они получают удовольствие от каприза, а не от добродетели, от зла, а не от добра, и от жестокости, а не от доброты.

LK_Goodness_Desc_4.en: Эгоцентричный человек стремится достичь своих целей любой ценой.Они запугивают слабых, используют в своих интересах добрых и даже устраняют тех, кто стоит у них на пути, — все, что угодно, лишь бы достичь своих целей.
LK_Goodness_Desc_4.cn: 世间唯我者，凌弱者，伐异己，党邪佞，欺良善。\n为达目的不择手段，唯利是图无情无义。
LK_Goodness_Desc_4.ru: Эгоцентричный человек стремится достичь своих целей любой ценой.Они запугивают слабых, используют в своих интересах добрых и даже устраняют тех, кто стоит у них на пути, — все, что угодно, лишь бы достичь своих целей.

LK_Goodness_Desc_Color_2.en: A <color=#BehaviorType_Even>Moderate</color> person embraces the principle of non-action, maintaining balance and neutrality in life. They go with the flow, seeking compromise and harmony in all things. With little concern for the division between right and wrong, perhaps they will eventually walk the enlightened path.

LK_LifeSkillCombat_Audience_Tips.en:
Select up to 3 companions or characters within 1-tile range as audience for this Debate.
During the Debate, audiences will comment on both sides' performances.
At the start of each round, audiences will apply with a chance special effects to squares on the stage.
If fewer than 3 characters are selected as audience, the remaining slots will be filled by those interested in this Debate.

选择至多3名同道或范围1以内地格的人物成为本次较艺的观众；

LK_LifeSkillCombat_Stage_Tip.en:
Each round consists of three distinct phases. After all three phases are complete, the next round begins.
Each Debate is limited to 20 rounds. When all 20 rounds are over, the side with more Perorations wins. If both sides have the same number of Perorations at the end of 20 rounds, the one as the first to move wins.

First-to-Move Phase: <color=#pinkyellow>The one as the first to move takes action during this phase</color>
Next-to-Move Phase: <color=#pinkyellow>The one as the next to move takes action during this phase</color>
Resolution Phase: <color=#pinkyellow>Both sides' Contentions advance 1 square along the Contention Path toward the opponent's heart square</color>
LK_LifeSkillCombat_Stage_Tip.cn:
每回合共分为三个不同的阶段，三个阶段结束后进入下一回合；
每场较艺共有20回合的限制，20个回合结束后，结论更多的一方获胜，如果结论相同则先手方获胜…

先手行动阶段：<color=#pinkyellow>先手方在此阶段进行操作</color>
后手行动阶段：<color=#pinkyellow>后手方在此阶段进行操作</color>
回合结算阶段：<color=#pinkyellow>双方论点延论证路线，向对方的心怀前进1格</color>

LK_LifeSkillCombat_Unit_Tip_Content.en:
When a Contention reaches the opponent's heart square, it destroys 1 Peroration of theirs.
Each Contention can carry up to 3 Strategies. When a Clash occurs, both the Arguments and Strategies attached to the Contention are revealed.
During a Clash, the side with fewer Arguments loses, and its Contention is removed. The winning Contention loses its Arguments by the number of the losing Contention's Arguments.
If both sides have equal Arguments, the Contention of the one as the first to move wins.
The winning Contention of the Clash restores Available Arguments for itself.
LK_LifeSkillCombat_Unit_Tip_Content.cn:
论点移动至对方心怀时，将消除对方的结论；
论点最多附着3个策略，发生论战将揭示论点的论据和策略；
论战中通过比较双方论据的大小进行判定，论据较小的一方失败，失败的论点将被消除，获胜论点根据失败论点的论据而减少自身论据；
如果双方论据相同则进攻的论点获胜；
在论战中获胜的一方将额外恢复可用论据…

LK_Mod_SetLegacy_Tip_Content.en:
Archive the DLLs currently used by the mod and <color=#orange>clear all DLL entries in the list</color>. References for the stable branch will be generated automatically. <color=#orange>After archiving, you must re-assign the DLLs your mod relies on...</color>

This is intended for maintaining mods that break in the test branch while keeping compatibility with the stable branch.
When a mod stops working in the test branch, back up the current version, clear the list, re-set the maintained DLL files, then save and upload to achieve dual-branch compatibility.
<color=#orange>Ensure that, when you click "Back Up," the DLL versions in the list are those compatible with the stable branch.</color>

<color=#lightgrey>This feature is recommended for use in the test branch only.</color>
LK_Mod_SetLegacy_Tip_Content.cn:
归档 Mod 当前使用的 Dll 并<color=#orange>清空列表中所有已设置的 Dll</color>，自动生成相关的引用提供给正式分支，<color=#orange>归档后需重新设置 Mod 所引用的 Dll…</color>

可用于维护在测试分支已失效的 Mod，同时保留对正式分支的兼容性。
使用方式为，在测试分支发现自己 Mod 失效后，备份当前版本，在列表清空后重新设置已维护的 Dll 文件，保存上传后就可以实现双分支兼容性。
<color=#orange>务必确保点击备份时列表中是正式分支可用的 Dll 版本。</color>

<color=#lightgrey>该功能仅推荐在测试分支使用</color>

LK_NewGame_Other_Encyclopedia_Desc.en:
The level of detail shown by default in the in-game encyclopedia.
Simple: View only basic terms and concept explanations...
Detailed: View more detailed game explanations in addition to basic descriptions...
Grandmaster: View all Taiwupedia information, including formulas and tables...

After setting the Taiwupedia display level, you can still readjust it later in the system settings...
LK_NewGame_Other_Encyclopedia_Desc.cn:
游戏百科默认展示的信息详细程度。
简易：仅查看最基本的名词、概念解释…
详细：在基本解释的基础上，查看更多详细的游戏内容说明…
大师：查看包括公式、表格在内的所有百晓册信息…

I'm sure you've made its acquaintance...\nI must apologize for that, and I assure you that it will soon be eliminated! Giant Ge will definitely be destroyed!

LK_Qi_Disorder_State_Content2.en:
·<color=#lightblue>Inner Breath Unimpeded</color> allows a character to <color=#lightblue>continuously restore Health when the month advances</color>.
·For a character, <color=#lightblue>the higher the Breath Control</color>, <color=#lightblue>the faster the Inner Breath Chaos decreases every month</color>.
·If Inner Breath Chaos reaches <color=#red>Suffering</color>, the character will <color=#red>lose Health</color> when the month advances.
·If Inner Breath Chaos reaches <color=#red>Hindered</color>, <color=#red>there is a certain probability of suffering Recoil when casting Martial Arts in combat.</color>...
·If Inner Breath Chaos reaches <color=#red>Hindered</color>, <color=#red>recovering True Qi during battle will additionally consume Qi</color>.
·If Inner Breath Chaos reaches <color=#red>Hindered</color>, the character's <color=#red>Toxin Resistance of all types will be reduced</color>.
·Higher Inner Breath Chaos will cause greater negative effects.
LK_Qi_Disorder_State_Content2.cn:
·保持<color=#lightblue>内息顺畅</color>，可以在<color=#lightblue>月份更替时持续恢复健康</color>…
·人物的<color=#lightblue>调息吐纳越高</color>，<color=#lightblue>内息紊乱每月自然降低得越快</color>…
·内息紊乱达到<color=#red>逆阻</color>后，月份更替时将会<color=#red>损耗健康</color>…
·内息紊乱达到<color=#red>滞碍</color>后，<color=#red>在战斗中施展功法时将有几率受到反噬</color>…
·内息紊乱达到<color=#red>滞碍</color>后，<color=#red>在战斗中补充真气时需要额外消耗内力</color>…
·内息紊乱达到<color=#red>滞碍</color>后，人物<color=#red>所有类型的毒素抵抗均会降低</color>…
·内息紊乱越高，造成的负面影响越严重…

LK_Qualification_Growth_Desc.en:
<color=#lightgrey>At each stage of a character's Total Age, their Talent will change based on their growth type...</color>

- Balanced: No change in Talent at any stage of the Total Age...
- Early Bloomer: At birth, <color=#brightblue>Talent increases by 15; the boost gradually decreases to 10 until the age of 40</color>. After the age of 40, <color=#brightred>Talent decreases by 10; the reduction gradually increases to 20 with the character's age growth.</color>
- Late Bloomer: At birth, <color=#brightred>Talent decreases by 20; the reduction gradually decreases to 10 until the age of 30</color>. After the age of 30, <color=#brightblue>Talent increases by 10; the boost gradually increases to 30 with the age growth</color>.
LK_Qualification_Growth_Desc.cn:
<color=#lightgrey>人物在各个的命龄阶段中，根据成长类型的不同，所有资质也会有所变化…</color>

·均衡：任何命龄阶段中，所有资质均无变化
·早熟：出生时<color=#brightblue>资质增加15，至40岁为止，此影响会随命龄增长逐渐递减至10</color>；40岁后<color=#brightred>资质减少10，此影响会随命龄增长逐渐递增至20</color>
·晚成：出生时<color=#brightred>资质减少20，至30岁为止，此影响会随命龄增长逐渐递减至10</color>；30岁后<color=#brightblue>资质增加10，此影响会随命龄增长逐渐递增至30</color>

LK_SectShaolinDemonSlayer_HelpTips.en: The Demonic Trials consist of nine stages. Each stage requires defeating a ruthless remnant of Degenerate. These shadows carry deep grudges and possess unique arts. Though you only battle their illusions and defeat won't mean death, the trial is fraught with danger. Bound by the illusory constraints, the trial leaves lasting scars on the body and mind. If overwhelmed, you may retreat temporarily and resume the trial later, continuing from your current progress...
LK_SectShaolinDemonSlayer_HelpTips.cn: 诛魔试炼共分九关，每关均需击败一位穷凶极恶的魔头残影;魔头残影怨念极深，各自身怀绝技;虽是与其残影观想作战，落败不至丧命;然试炼之中危机四伏，且观想之间身受拘囿，试炼者身随心变，仍会留下伤残;若力有不逮，或可暂且撤退，日后可承续当前进程再行试炼……

LK_TestBranchInvite_Content4.en:
- In the latest test branch, you can continue using your saves from the default branch by following these steps:
1. In your Steam Library, right-click on [The Scroll Of Taiwu], select [Manage], and choose "Browse local files" to open the game's root directory.
2. The saves from the default branch are located in the Save folder, while the test branch save files are stored in the Save_test folder. World_1 to world_5 correspond to the first through fifth save slots in the game.
3. Copy the corresponding save folders from Save to Save_test, and you can resume playing with your existing saves in the test branch.
LK_TestBranchInvite_Content4.cn:
-在最新测试分支中，您依然可以沿用默认游戏分支的存档，操作的方法是：
1、进入Steam游戏库，右键选中【太吾绘卷】，在【管理】中选择浏览本地文件，即可进入游戏根目录。
2、默认游戏分支的存档位于根目录下的Save文件夹中，测试分支的存档位于Save_test文件夹中，文件夹里的world_1 ~ 5，分别对应游戏里第一至第五存档栏中的存档。
3、只需将Save文件夹中，对应的存档文件夹复制到Save_test文件夹里，便可沿用默认游戏分支的存档，继续游玩。

LK_TestBranchInvite_Content5.en: The latest test branch includes richer game content, and we're still improving the updates.\nCompared with the default branch, the test branch may be less stable and cause unexpected issues or suboptimal gameplay experiences. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and kindly ask for your understanding.\nPlease remember to back up your save files regularly during gameplay.
LK_TestBranchInvite_Content5.cn: 最新测试分支中会包含更为丰富的游戏内容，与此同时，我们也在对更新内容进行持续完善。\n相比默认游戏分支，最新测试分支可能不够稳定，有一定报错及体验不佳的可能，还请您多多包涵。\n对此造成的不良游戏体验，我们深感愧疚！请您在游戏过程中，及时备份存档。

LK_TestBranchInvite_Content7.en:
If you encounter a bug while playing (including errors, crashes, animation or icon issues):
1. Take a screenshot and recall how the bug was triggered.
2. You may close the game while reporting the bug, but please do not relaunch it until the submission is done, as reopening the game will overwrite the Log file. You may resume playing afterward.
3. Minimize or close the game, go to [AppData\LocalLow\Conchship\The Scroll of Taiwu], find the file named [Player.log], and save it.
4. Go to the game's root directory, locate the save slot where the issue occurred, and compress the corresponding save folder (world_1 to world_5 correspond to the first through fifth save slots in the game).
5. Select [Feedback] in the game's [System] option, then go to [Submit Issue] > [Submit Bug], upload the required files to complete your bug report.
LK_TestBranchInvite_Content7.cn:
若您在游戏过程中遇到Bug（无论游戏报错、卡死、动画及图标错误等）：
1、请您先保存游戏截图，并回忆触发BUG的操作步骤。
2、提交BUG期间可以将游戏关闭，但请不要再次开启，再次开启会导致Log文件刷新丢失，您可以在提交结束后再继续游玩。
3、将游戏最小化或者关闭，然后前往：“AppData\LocalLow\Conchship\The Scroll of Taiwu”中寻找到“Player.log”文件，并将其保存。
4、进入游戏根目录，并将您在游玩时出现问题的存档打包压缩（world_1 ~ 5存档文件夹序号，对应您在游戏中的存档排序）。
5、点击游戏系统选项中的【问题反馈】，之后在【提交问题】>【提交BUG】页面，上传附件，您遇到的Bug便已反馈完成。

LK_Tips_TransferInfection_Target_Content.cn: 相枢邪念表示人物入魔的程度，当人物内心累积了过多的相枢邪念，人物便会入魔成为失心人\n若人物的相枢邪念达到100，人物将获得「相枢入邪」\n若人物的相枢邪念达到200，人物将获得「相枢化魔」
LK_Tips_TransferInfection_Target_Content.ru: Злая воля Сяншу указывает на степень Искажения характера; когда она накапливается чрезмерно, персонаж становится одержимым и околдованным.\nAt 100 Злая воля Сяншу, персонаж получает "Манию Сяншу"\nAt 200, персонаж получает "Одержимый Сяншу"

UI_AdventureEditor_Tips_IdInput.en:
1. Enter an ID within the given range not exceeding 32767.
2. If the ID already exists, you'll switch to and edit the existing Encounter.
3. If the ID doesn't exist and you're editing an existing Encounter, replace the ID you've entered for this Encounter.
4. If the ID doesn't exist and you're editing a new Encounter, assign the ID to this Encounter.
UI_AdventureEditor_Tips_IdInput.cn:
1、输入一个划分给自己的范围内的id，id最大值不可以超过32767
2、输入的奇遇id已经存在：切换到目标奇遇并编辑
3、输入的奇遇id不存在且正在编辑一个已经存在的奇遇：则修改该奇遇的id
4、输入的奇遇id不存在且正在编辑一个新的奇遇：则为该新奇遇分配id

UI_EventEditor_Tip_ItemInsertString_Cont.en:
1. Enclose the placeholder label within <>.
2. Item placeholders use the label "Item."
3. Key fields signify that the item information will be retrieved from the parameter box.
4. Key fields render ID and Type fields invalid.
5. ID and Type fields must always be used together.
6. Str fields signify that this placeholder will be substituted with strings.
7. The value of str fields can be "Name" or "ColorName."
8. Sp fields signify that this placeholder will be substituted with icons.
9. The value of sp fields can only be "Icon."
UI_EventEditor_Tip_ItemInsertString_Cont.cn:
1、使用<>包含整个占位符标签信息
2、所有道具的占位符标签名都是 Item
3、key字段表示从参数盒获取该物品信息
4、key字段存在会使id字段和type字段失效
5、type字段和id字段必须总是成对出现
6、str字段表示该占位符替换为字符串
7、str字段可选值有Name和ColorName
8、sp字段表示该占位符替换为物品图标
9、sp字段的值总是Icon
